message.content: Based on the feedback provided by Li Hua in the progress tracking discussions, there are no specific new species of flowers mentioned that will be added to the community garden renovation. The only suggestion made was regarding the addition of native plants to attract more butterflies and bees, but no particular types of flowers were specified. Li Hua suggested lavender and coneflowers as examples of native plants, but she did not indicate these or other specific flowers would be included in the garden renovation.
